Elements matching CSS attribute selector are excluded entirely

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<body><div role="complementary">Sidebar</div><p>Primary text</p></body>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"exclude_selectors":["[role='complementary']"]}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
